problems.symptom: Users can receive 'Не удалось загрузить сайт' before the real page is rendered.
problems.root_cause: Production currently serves a small browser bootstrap that fetches p0.bin..p4.bin and reconstructs/decompresses the real HTML client-side instead of serving the verified self-contained dist/index.html directly.
problems.fix_strategy: Deploy the repository-generated self-contained artifact directly and add release/live smoke gates that reject binary/bootstrap delivery.
problems.completion_gate: The public production URL directly contains the self-contained build marker and required recruitment UI markers, contains no binary bootstrap markers, and passes scripts/production-smoke.mjs.

problems.symptom: A merged, green source change does not guarantee the public Vercel domain is running that build.
problems.root_cause: The current Vercel project is not Git-linked, so source CI and public production are separate authorities.
problems.fix_strategy: Make the GitHub release workflow the deterministic deployment owner when credentials are available, then require a live production smoke after deployment.
problems.completion_gate: A push to project/kyokushin-nn can deploy the verified build without manual repackaging and the same workflow proves the public URL.
